reviews.body: Approved. Text parts in array content now survive for system, developer and assistant messages, and an empty system string omits `systemInstruction` instead of sending an empty part. Follow-ups we'll add on our side: tests for assistant parts with `tool_calls` (text before `functionCall`), the `developer` role with parts, and empty system content leaving out `systemInstruction`. The commit's Co-Authored-By trailer fails our attribution check, so we'll squash-merge with our own message.

Merge Risk: Minimal · previous review 4444f

This change makes Gemini and Vertex requests keep array-form text content for system, developer, and assistant messages, which were previously dropped. Regression tests cover the main cases and no concrete defects were found. The only visible CI failure is a commit-message attribution check that should be addressed separately.
Security architecture risk: Minimal · up to 4444f

The change preserves text that was previously dropped from structured messages. The reviewed change does not let callers take on new roles, grant new tool permissions, or send data to a new destination. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The changed behavior applies to requests already routed through this Vertex chat adapter that carry array-valued system, developer, or assistant content. It expands the text visible to the model, not the set of roles the adapter recognizes. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Role labels supplied in the request determine which model field receives the text; the converter does not authenticate those labels. Array items can emit only text parts. Function-call parts still come from the separate assistant tool_calls field.
